tests.name: unsorted
tests.formula:
With({TextRecognizer1:{Results:Table({Text:"BOTTOM",BoundingBox:{Top:80,Left:0},PageNumber:1},{Text:"TOP",BoundingBox:{Top:2,Left:0},PageNumber:1},{Text:"MIDDLE",BoundingBox:{Top:25,Left:0},PageNumber:1})}},With({candidates:SortByColumns(
                    AddColumns(
                        Filter(
                            TextRecognizer1.Results,
                            !IsBlank(TrimEnds(Text)) &&
                            !IsBlank(BoundingBox.Top) && BoundingBox.Top >= 0
                        ),
                        OcrTop, BoundingBox.Top,
                        OcrLeft, Coalesce(BoundingBox.Left, 0),
                        OcrPage, Coalesce(PageNumber, 1)
                    ),
                    "OcrTop", SortOrder.Ascending,
                    "OcrPage", SortOrder.Ascending,
                    "OcrLeft", SortOrder.Ascending,
                    "Text", SortOrder.Ascending
                )},Coalesce(First(candidates).Text,"EMPTY")))
